regions.summary: Micang mountains: Nanjiang, Wangcang and the Cangxi hills (Daba foothills north of Bazhong).

candidates.name: Micang
candidates.meaning: "Rice granary mountain": the range between the Han and Jialing basins, crossed by the old Micang road from Hanzhong into Sichuan.
candidates.fit: Its core karst peaks lie around the Wangcang and Nanjiang border, i.e. the middle of this region.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 214 hits with 四川, top ones about this range.
candidates.source_note: 最典型的峰丛分布在米仓山中部的四川旺苍县和南江县接界一带；国家级自然保护区

candidates.name: Nanjiang
candidates.meaning: "South river": named for the Nan river (a Bazhong headwater); county since 1516.
candidates.fit: Nanjiang county is 49% of the region's people and almost wholly inside.
candidates.source_note: 集州，州治所在今南江镇；Nanjiang county 1516-1911

regions.notes: Daba is the wider range; Micang is its western part and fits the Wangcang/Nanjiang heartland better.

regions.summary: Guangyuan city on the upper Jialing: Lizhou, Zhaohua, Cangxi's river towns.

candidates.name: Guangyuan
candidates.meaning: Name of the city; Guangyuan county from 1389, the Ming-Qing county seat that became the prefecture.
candidates.fit: Holds the old centre (Lizhou district is 60% of the people).
candidates.source_note: 利州区；广元县 1389-1911, seat today's Guangyuan

candidates.name: Lizhou
candidates.meaning: Tang and Song prefecture, from 554 to 1236, seated at Guangyuan; later Lizhou circuit (Lizhou lu) covered northern Sichuan.
candidates.fit: Seat is this region; the prefecture covered Zhaohua and Cangxi too.
candidates.recognisability: Is also the present district name (Lizhou district), so it is known locally; Guangyuan is better for the city centre.
candidates.source_note: 利州 (州, 554-1236) 今四川省广元市

regions.notes: Zhaohua (old Jiameng pass of Liu Bei's march into Shu) is only 15% of the people; 43 zh-wiki hits with 四川 for 葭萌, so I left it out.

regions.summary: Daba mountain interior: Tongjiang, Wanyuan, and the Zhenba corner of Shaanxi.

candidates.name: Tongjiang
candidates.meaning: "Through river": the Tong river, which runs down from the Daba mountains (the old Bizhou seat).
candidates.fit: Tongjiang county is 51% of the people and 90% of it is inside; the Tong river runs through the region.
candidates.recognisability: Current county, a Red Army base area.

candidates.name: Wanyuan
candidates.meaning: "Ten-thousand sources": county-level city, formerly Taiping county, renamed in 1950s.
candidates.fit: Wanyuan city is 34% of the people and almost wholly inside; the Dazhou prefecture's northern end.
candidates.source_note: 太平县 (1515-1911) 今万源县治

candidates.name: Daba
candidates.meaning: The range between the Han and Jialing basins on the Sichuan, Shaanxi, Chongqing and Hubei border.
candidates.fit: This region is the Daba's heart, but the range is much larger and also reaches the Chongqing and Shaanxi neighbours.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 396 hits with 四川.
candidates.source_note: 狭义的大巴山位于四川、重庆、陕西、湖北省边境，是汉水与嘉陵江的分水岭

regions.notes: Daba may be wanted by the Chongqing or Shaanxi side; use it here only if nobody else takes it.

regions.summary: Jianmen pass and the old Shu road: Jiange, Zitong, upper Jiangyou.

candidates.name: Jianmen
candidates.meaning: "Sword gate": the Jianmen pass (Jianmenguan), one of China's four great passes, on the Shu road through the Jiange ridge.
candidates.fit: Pass sits in Jianmenguan town, inside the region; the region is the road from Zitong to Jiange.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 402 hits with 四川, top ones about this place.
candidates.source_note: 剑门关镇 in Jiange; 与雁门关、函谷关、仙霞关并称中国四大古关口

candidates.name: Jiange
candidates.meaning: "Sword pavilion": the plank-road pavilion at the pass.
candidates.fit: Jiange county is 36% of the people and wholly inside.
candidates.source_note: 剑阁县内雄险的剑门关

candidates.name: Zitong
candidates.meaning: Catalpa river; seat of the Han Guanghan commandery, and the Wenchang god's temple.
candidates.fit: Zitong is 24% of the people and wholly inside; the Han-era commandery and Zitong river are in this region.
candidates.source_note: 广汉郡 (116 BC-119) 今梓潼县治

regions.notes: Jiangyou city (25% here, most of it in region 6) is the other big unit; I'd give Jiangyou to region 6.

regions.summary: Bazhong city: Bazhou and Enyang.

candidates.name: Bazhong
candidates.meaning: "Within Ba": the city and prefecture, built round the old Bazhou.
candidates.fit: The central region (Bazhou district 71%, Enyang 28%).
candidates.source_note: 巴州 (514-1276) 今四川省巴中县

candidates.name: Enyang
candidates.meaning: Enyang river and ancient town (Enyang county 598-1282).
candidates.fit: Enyang is 28% of the people and entirely inside.
candidates.recognisability: Current district, a known old river town.
candidates.source_note: 恩阳县 (598-1282) 今巴中县西南恩阳

regions.summary: Fu river plain north of Mianyang: Jiangyou (Li Bai's home county), Youxian.

candidates.name: Jiangyou
candidates.meaning: Named for the Jiangyou pass on the road to Yinping (Jiangyou county since 1380); Li Bai's home.
candidates.fit: Jiangyou city is 53% of the people, with 56% of the city inside; the other part is in region 4.
candidates.source_note: 江油县 (1380-1911) 今江油县治

candidates.name: Zhangming
candidates.meaning: "Bright and plain": Zhangming county (Li Bai's birth county), 923 to 1911.
candidates.fit: Seat at Zhangming town, today's Jiangyou south; covers the Jiangyou plain half.
candidates.recognisability: Not checked; known mainly as Li Bai's home county.
candidates.source_note: 彰明县 (923-1911) 今四川省江油县南彰明镇

regions.summary: Bazhong's eastern hills: Pingchang with parts of Bazhou, Yilong, Dachuan.

candidates.name: Pingchang
candidates.meaning: Coined in 1946 from the two older names Pingzhou and Tongchang.
candidates.fit: Pingchang county is 57% of the people, 95% of it inside.
candidates.source_note: 取“平州”、“同昌”首尾各一字命名

regions.notes: A Ba river name (the Ba river rises in Pingchang/Bazhou) scored weakly: 328 hits with 四川 but mostly Hubei and Xinjiang places. Shining county (始宁, 440 years) has no article of its own.

regions.summary: Mountain edge north of Mianyang and Deyang: Anzhou, Luojiang, Beichuan's lower end.

candidates.name: Anzhou
candidates.meaning: Former An county (Anxian, since 1374), now Anzhou district; the Song-Yuan Anzhou.
candidates.fit: An county is 39% of the people and almost all inside.

candidates.name: Luojiang
candidates.meaning: "Luo river": county from 742 to 1769 and again; the river runs through the region.
candidates.fit: Luojiang is 22% of the people, 97% of it inside.
candidates.source_note: 罗江县 (742-1769) 今德阳县东北罗江镇

candidates.name: Beichuan
candidates.meaning: "North river": the Beichuan Qiang autonomous county, named for the Beichuan city site.
candidates.fit: Only 15% of the people here, though 61% of Beichuan county's people are inside; the new town (Yongchang) is here.
candidates.source_note: 北周天和元年（566年）置北川县，因县西北有北川城而得名

regions.notes: Longan (龙安) was checked: Longan prefecture was Pingwu, not this area.

regions.summary: Xuanhan county in the Daba foothills northeast of Dazhou.

candidates.name: Xuanhan
candidates.meaning: Han-era county of the Dongxiang area (renamed Xuanhan in 1914 after the old Xuanhan county of 557).
candidates.fit: Xuanhan county is 88% of the people and 97% of it is inside.
candidates.source_note: 建制始於東漢永元八年（96年），1914年改東鄉縣为宣汉县

regions.notes: Puguang (the gas field town) had only 40 hits with 四川; Dongxiang is better known as the Gansu Dongxiang people.

regions.summary: Zhu De's county Yilong with parts of Langzhong and Nanbu.

candidates.name: Yilong
candidates.meaning: Yilong county since 502 (as Yilong 仪隆), once the seat of Pengzhou.
candidates.fit: Yilong county is 57% of the people, 85% of it inside.
candidates.source_note: 蓬州 (741-1257) 今四川省仪陇县大营镇; 仪隆县 (502-1911)

regions.notes: Pengzhou 蓬州 has the same pinyin as Pengzhou 彭州 near Chengdu, so left out.

regions.summary: Mianyang city centre: Fucheng and Youxian urban parts.

candidates.name: Mianyang
candidates.meaning: "Sunny side of the Mian": the Mian river; Mianzhou was seated here from 585.
candidates.fit: The central region (Fucheng 79%).
candidates.source_note: 绵州 (585-1911) 今四川省绵阳市东开元场

candidates.name: Fucheng
candidates.meaning: "Fu river city": the central district, named for the Fu river and the old Fu county.
candidates.fit: Fucheng is 79% of the people.
candidates.source_note: 涪县 (201 BC-552) 今绵阳市东一里涪江东岸

regions.summary: Langzhong ancient city and Nanbu on the Jialing.

candidates.name: Langzhong
candidates.meaning: "Within the Lang": the city lies inside the Lang hills and the Lang water bend of the Jialing; county since 314 BC.
candidates.fit: Langzhong is 35% of the people but holds the old centre; the seat of Langzhou and Baoning prefecture.
candidates.recognisability: County-level city, ancient city on the tourism list.

candidates.name: Nanbu
candidates.meaning: "The southern part": county from 502, south of Langzhong.
candidates.fit: Nanbu county is 61% of the people, 64% of it inside.

candidates.name: Baoning
candidates.meaning: "Preserving peace": Baoning prefecture (1276-1911) seated at Langzhong; also known for its vinegar.
candidates.fit: Prefecture covered the whole Langzhong, Nanbu, Cangxi area.
candidates.recognisability: Not checked; known for the vinegar.
candidates.source_note: 保宁府 (府, 1276-1911) 今四川省阆中县

regions.summary: Dazhou city centre: Tongchuan and urban Dachuan.

candidates.name: Dazhou
candidates.meaning: Dazhou prefecture 965 to 1801; the name Da ("reaching") from Tongzhou.
candidates.fit: The central region of the city (Tongchuan 59%, Dachuan 41%).
candidates.source_note: 达州 (965-1801) 今四川省达州市

candidates.name: Tongchuan
candidates.meaning: "Through the rivers": the Tongchuan district, from the old Tongzhou and Tongchuan commandery.
candidates.fit: Tongchuan is 59% of the people.
candidates.recognisability: Current district; same pinyin as Tongchuan (铜川) in Shaanxi.
candidates.source_note: 通川县 (598-1375) 今达州市治

regions.summary: Dachuan plains and Kaijiang around Dazhou.

candidates.name: Dachuan
candidates.meaning: Short for Dazhou's Chuan: the district was Da county until 2013.
candidates.fit: Dachuan is 47% of the people (51% of the district inside).

candidates.name: Kaijiang
candidates.meaning: "Open river": the Kaijiang county, formerly Xinning.
candidates.fit: Kaijiang is 30% of the people and 81% of it is inside.
candidates.source_note: 开州 (529-1277) 今四川省开江县

regions.notes: Kaizhou (the old prefecture) is now the Kaizhou district in Chongqing, so not suggested.

regions.summary: Santai on the Fu river: the old Zizhou and Tongchuan prefecture seat.

candidates.name: Zizhou
candidates.meaning: "Catalpa prefecture": Tang and Song prefecture seated at Santai (618-1117); gave its name to the Zizhou circuit, one of the four circuits that gave Sichuan its name.
candidates.fit: Seat at Santai (82% of the region); the prefecture also covered Yanting and Shehong.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 114 hits with 四川, top ones about this place (Zizhou circuit).
candidates.source_note: 梓州 (州, 618-1117) 今四川省三台县

candidates.name: Santai
candidates.meaning: "Three platforms": county since 1734 (as seat of Tongchuan prefecture).
candidates.fit: Santai is 82% of the people.

regions.notes: Tongchuan prefecture (潼川) has the same pinyin as Dazhou's Tongchuan, so I did not list it.

regions.summary: Hills between the Fu and Jialing: Yanting, Xichong, Pengxi, Shehong.

candidates.name: Yanting
candidates.meaning: "Salt pavilion": county since 535, after the salt springs and the Yanting salt works.
candidates.fit: Yanting is 30% of the people, wholly inside.
candidates.source_note: 盐亭县 (535-1911) 今盐亭县治

candidates.name: Xichong
candidates.meaning: "West Chong": named Xichongguo in 221 after the old Chongguo county; county in its present name since 621.
candidates.fit: Xichong is 29% of the people (79% of the county inside).
candidates.source_note: 蜀汉章武元年改充国县为西充国；武德四年改晋城县为西充县

regions.notes: A hill region of four counties with no river or range name that fits.

regions.summary: Jialing east bank: Peng'an (Sima Xiangru's home) and Yingshan.

candidates.name: Peng'an
candidates.meaning: "Peaceful Peng": from Pengzhou, the Peng hills; Sima Xiangru's home county.
candidates.fit: Peng'an is 49% of the people and 97% of it is inside.
candidates.source_note: 相如县 (507-1376) 今蓬安县锦屏镇

candidates.name: Yingshan
candidates.meaning: "Camp mountain": county from 1012.
candidates.fit: Yingshan is 49% of the people (73% of the county inside).

regions.summary: The Qu river county and its old Cong people lands.

candidates.name: Quxian
candidates.meaning: "Canal county": county since 1376; Qu prefecture earlier; the Qu river.
candidates.fit: Qu county is 89% of the people, 97% of it inside.

candidates.name: Dangqu
candidates.meaning: Han-era Dangqu county (314 BC to 964) and commandery, land of the Cong people.
candidates.fit: Seat at Chengba village in Qu county; covered the region.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article (宕渠縣), 83 hits with 四川.
candidates.source_note: 宕渠县 (314 BC-964) 今渠县土溪乡城坝村

regions.summary: The ring round Nanchong city: Gaoping, Jialing and Shunqing's outer parts.

candidates.name: Jialing
candidates.meaning: The Jialing river, which runs through the three Nanchong districts; also a district name.
candidates.fit: Jialing district is 30% of the people; the river runs through the region's middle.
candidates.recognisability: Current district; the river is well known.
candidates.source_note: 嘉陵区因地处嘉陵江而得名

candidates.name: Gaoping
candidates.meaning: "High flat": the Gaoping town, which gave the district its name.
candidates.fit: Gaoping is 37% of the people, 78% of it inside.
candidates.source_note: 高坪区区政府所在地为高坪镇，区以此得名

regions.notes: Other agents may use Jialing for the river further south.

regions.summary: Nanchong city centre (Shunqing and urban Gaoping and Jialing).

candidates.name: Nanchong
candidates.meaning: Nanchong county from 598, Nanchongguo before it; "south of Chong".
candidates.fit: The central region of the city (Shunqing 64%).
candidates.source_note: 南充县 (598-1911) 今南充市舞凤乡清泉坝

candidates.name: Shunqing
candidates.meaning: Shunqing prefecture (1227-1911), renamed from Guozhou after the Song emperor Lizong's early post.
candidates.fit: Seat is this region, covering Nanchong, Xichong and others.
candidates.source_note: 顺庆府 (1227-1911) 今南充市舞凤乡清泉坝

regions.summary: Dazhu county on the Huaying ridges.

candidates.name: Dazhu
candidates.meaning: "Big bamboo": county since 1283.
candidates.fit: Dazhu is 77% of the people and 98% of it is inside.

regions.summary: Yuechi county and the western Guang'an district.

candidates.name: Yuechi
candidates.meaning: Named for the Si Yue pool on the Anyue mountain 30 li east of the county.
candidates.fit: Yuechi is 65% of the people, 89% of it inside.
candidates.source_note: 因县东三十里有安岳山，山上有思岳池而得名

regions.summary: Guang'an city: Guang'an district, Qianfeng, Huaying.

candidates.name: Guang'an
candidates.meaning: "Broad lands settled": from the Guang'an army set up in 969; Deng Xiaoping's home.
candidates.fit: The central region (Guang'an district 47%, Qianfeng 29%).
candidates.source_note: 广安军 (969-1265) 今四川省广安县治

candidates.name: Huaying
candidates.meaning: The Huaying mountains, a parallel ridge running from Wanyuan to Yongchuan; also the Huaying city.
candidates.fit: Huaying city is 17% of the people; the range runs along the east edge into the Dazhu and Linshui regions.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article (華鎣山), also a county-level city.
candidates.source_note: 華鎣山，亦稱西山，古稱華銀山，位於四川盆地東北部

regions.notes: Huaying also fits regions 21 and 25 along the ridge; use it once.

regions.summary: Wusheng and the Jialing, Fu and Qu river confluence at Hechuan.

candidates.name: Wusheng
candidates.meaning: "Martial victory": from the Song-Yuan Wusheng army; a military name but the plain current county name.
candidates.fit: Wusheng is 44% of the people and 89% of the county is inside.
candidates.source_note: 武胜军 (1267-1277) 今武胜县南旧县场

candidates.name: Hechuan
candidates.meaning: "Rivers joined": Hechuan, where the Jialing, Fu and Qu meet; the Diaoyu fortress held off Mongke Khan here.
candidates.fit: Hechuan is 29% of the people, only 26% of the district inside.
candidates.source_note: 地处嘉陵江、涪江、渠江三江汇合之处，因三江汇流而得名

regions.notes: Hechuan is mostly in Chongqing and the Chongqing agent may use it. Dingyuan (定远, seat 1287-1911) means "settle the distant", also a famous Anhui name, so left out.

regions.summary: Linshui county and the Chongqing strip along the Huaying ridge.

candidates.name: Linshui
candidates.meaning: "Neighbouring water": Linshui county since 964 (Linshui 邻水 from the Linshui river).
candidates.fit: Linshui is 52% of the people, 99% of the county inside.
candidates.source_note: 邻水县 (619-1911) 今邻水县北二十里

regions.notes: The Chongqing parts (Yubei 30%, Beibei 11%) may be named by the Chongqing agent; check it against Yubei.
